facts.text: Hidden Pond sits on 60 acres of birch groves and balsam fir in Kennebunkport, Maine.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by 60 acres of birch groves and balsam fir in Kennebunkport, Maine

facts.text: The resort is minutes from Goose Rocks Beach.
facts.excerpt: all just minutes from Goose Rocks Beach

facts.text: The resort has two outdoor swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: our private luxury resort features two outdoor swimming pools

facts.text: The Tree Spa is a three-room treetop spa.
facts.excerpt: a three-room treetop spa

facts.text: The Tree Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments and overlooks the birch forest from eight feet above the ground.
facts.excerpt: Choose from a selection of massages, facials, and body treatments at our peaceful Tree Spa, overlooking the birch forest from eight feet above the ground.

facts.text: The Serenity pool is adults-only.
facts.excerpt: Our adults-only Serenity pool provides a sweet escape for swimming, sunning, and diving into a good book, sans kids.

facts.text: The Lodge pool is the family pool.
facts.excerpt: Family fun awaits at the Lodge pool

facts.text: The one-bedroom bungalows were created with New York City fashion designer Todd Snyder, each with its own theme inspired by Maine's natural beauty.
facts.excerpt: Created in collaboration with New York City fashion designer Todd Snyder, each features a unique theme inspired by Maine

facts.text: Each one-bedroom bungalow has a stone fireplace, king bed, marble bathroom and an outdoor rain shower framed by forest views.
facts.excerpt: a stone fireplace, plush king bed, marble bathroom, and an outdoor rain shower framed by forest views

facts.text: Todd Snyder designed The From Away Lodge, celebrating Maine's heritage with L.L.Bean upholstery.
facts.excerpt: menswear designer Todd Snyder put his signature touch on The From Away Lodge

facts.text: The From Away Lodge has a signature fragrance created with Kennebunkport's Sea Love Candles.
facts.excerpt: Snyder even partnered with Kennebunkport

facts.text: Each Treetop Lodge combines a studio and a one-bedroom suite, inspired by treehouses and mountainside retreats.
facts.excerpt: each Treetop Lodge is comprised of a studio and a one-bedroom suite, with ample room for up to 5 guests - all inspired by treehouses and mountainside retreats.

facts.text: The two-bedroom cottages have a gourmet kitchen, living room and fireplace.
facts.excerpt: With a gourmet kitchen, cozy living room, fireplace, and flat-screen TV

facts.text: Hideaways come with a morning bakery basket delivery.
facts.excerpt: Morning bakery basket delivery

facts.text: Cottages have down-filled duvets and Frette linens.
facts.excerpt: Down-filled duvets and Frette linens

facts.text: Earth at Hidden Pond is the resort's organic restaurant.
facts.excerpt: organic dining at our award-winning restaurant Earth at Hidden Pond

facts.text: A free shuttle takes guests to lunch at the sister property, The Tides Beach Club.
facts.excerpt: Or hop on our free shuttle for lunch at our sister property, The Tides Beach Club.

facts.text: Guests can pick strawberries or tomatoes at the resort's organic garden.
facts.excerpt: Gather a basket of fresh strawberries or sun-ripened tomatoes for a light summer salad at our organic garden

facts.text: A nightly bonfire at the Lodge is set up for s'mores.
facts.excerpt: Kids of all ages will delight in the simple pleasure of toasting marshmallows over an open fire each night at the Lodge.

facts.text: Forest bathing is led by certified Forest Therapy Guide Jeanne Christie.
facts.excerpt: Connect to nature through the Japanese-inspired practice of forest bathing, led by certified Forest Therapy Guide, Jeanne Christie.

facts.text: An outdoor slow-flow yoga class is held every morning by the garden, weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: Join us every morning at 8am for an outdoor, slow flow class by our garden.

facts.text: Guests get a complimentary two-hour kayak or canoe ride launching from downtown Kennebunkport with Kennebunkport Marina.
facts.excerpt: Experience a complimentary 2-hour kayak or canoe ride and launch from downtown Kennebunkport with our friends at Kennebunkport Marina.

facts.text: For a beach day the resort provides lounge chairs, towels, water and sunscreen.
facts.excerpt: lounge chairs, towels, water and sunscreen

facts.text: Maine native species from the Center for Wildlife visit the garden on Tuesday afternoons from June through August.
facts.excerpt: Tuesday afternoons June through August in our garden.

facts.text: The resort describes itself as ideal for family vacations, group getaways and romantic retreats.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for family vacations, group getaways, and romantic retreats

facts.text: The fitness studio has Peloton bikes, NordicTrack treadmills and Hydrow rowing machines.
facts.excerpt: complete with Peloton bikes, NordicTrack treadmills, and Hydrow rowing machines

facts.text: Dog-friendly bungalows and cottages are available.
facts.excerpt: Reserve our dog-friendly Bungalows

facts.text: Kayaks and stand-up paddleboards are seasonal.
facts.excerpt: Borrow one of our new L.L. Bean kayaks or stand-up paddleboards and explore. (seasonal)

facts.text: Treetop Suites and Studios are available for select nights throughout the season.
facts.excerpt: Available for select nights throughout the season.

facts.text: Golf cart rentals require reservations and rental fees apply.
facts.excerpt: Reservations required and rental fees apply.

facts.text: USA Today Readers' Choice Awards 2024 voted Hidden Pond the number one destination resort in the US.
facts.excerpt: voted the #1 Best destination Resort in US by USA Today Readers' Choice Awards 2024
